result.instructions: Tools for MailerCheck, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many MailerCheck verification credits remain?"; "Show my email verification lists and their status."; "Verify this email after I confirm the credit charge, then read its result.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MailerCheck data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mailercheck_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mailercheck_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mailercheck_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. mailercheck_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mailercheck_account
tools.title: Read MailerCheck account
tools.description: Read the connected MailerCheck account name, ID and credit balance. Does not verify emails or spend verification credits.

tools.name: mailercheck_credits
tools.title: Check MailerCheck credits
tools.description: Read the available MailerCheck verification credit balance without starting verification.

tools.name: mailercheck_lists
tools.title: List MailerCheck verification lists
tools.description: Read one bounded page of list summaries, processing status and statistics. Does not create, verify or delete lists. Pagination stays on the MailerCheck API; no response links are followed.

tools.name: mailercheck_get_list
tools.title: Read MailerCheck list status
tools.description: Read one existing list's verification status and aggregate result counts. Does not start or restart verification.

tools.name: mailercheck_verify_email
tools.title: Start MailerCheck email verification
tools.description: Submit one email for asynchronous verification. Spends MailerCheck credits and requires confirm:true. This call is never retried. Read the returned verification ID with mailercheck_verification_result; wait between polls. If the response is lost, check MailerCheck before submitting again.

tools.name: mailercheck_verification_result
tools.title: Read MailerCheck email verification result
tools.description: Read the status and result of a previously submitted asynchronous email check. Does not start new verification. Call once and wait before polling again; no automatic polling is performed.
